data.name: PluginDescription
data.value: Safe media-information extraction and short-lived redirect preparation for local STRM files.

data.name: EditorTitle
data.value: STRM Bridge

data.name: EditorDescription
data.value: Safely extracts technical media information and exposes an optional short-lived redirect source.

data.name: Enabled
data.value: Enable plugin

data.name: EnablePlaybackSource
data.value: Enable STRM Bridge playback

data.name: EnablePlaybackSourceDescription
data.value: Enabled by default. When disabled, the plugin only extracts media information; the server and clients continue using the original STRM source.

data.name: ExtractAfterLibraryScan
data.value: Extract after library scan

data.name: OnlyMissingMediaInfo
data.value: Only extract missing media information

data.name: OnlyMissingMediaInfoDescription
data.value: Enabled: unchanged complete technical information is skipped and matching snapshots may restore missing data; playback classification may still use a headers-only check without FFmpeg. Disabled: every selected STRM is probed again and its snapshot is replaced.

data.name: EnablePersistence
data.value: Persist media information

data.name: MaximumExtractionConcurrency
data.value: Maximum extraction concurrency

data.name: ExtractionTimeoutSeconds
data.value: Per-item timeout in seconds

data.name: IncludedLibraryIds
data.value: Included media libraries

data.name: IncludedLibraryIdsDescription
data.value: Select one or more Emby media libraries. Leave empty to disable all STRM Bridge processing.

data.name: DetectedRedirectHosts
data.value: Detected redirect hosts

data.name: DetectedRedirectHostsDescription
data.value: Select only pending hostnames you trust and save. Trusted detections remain listed and marked; saving new trust automatically retries waiting media. You can also enter exact hosts or an explicit subdomain rule such as *.example.com below. Full URLs, paths, and query strings are never retained; visibly copied long query values are rejected before detection.

data.name: TrustedHostSuffix
data.value: (trusted)

data.name: AllowedRedirectHosts
data.value: Additional trusted redirect hosts

data.name: AllowedRedirectHostsDescription
data.value: Cross-host redirect targets trusted for server-side probing. Enter an exact host or *.example.com to trust all of its subdomains; the wildcard does not include example.com itself. Same-host redirects are always allowed; leave empty to reject other hosts.

data.name: AwaitingApprovalNotificationTitle
data.value: STRM Bridge is waiting for approval

data.name: AwaitingApprovalNotificationDescription
data.value: Detected {0} unapproved redirect host(s). Some media are waiting for approval. Open STRM Bridge settings to review them.

data.name: RetryCompletedNotificationTitle
data.value: STRM Bridge automatic retry completed

data.name: RetryCompletedNotificationDescription
data.value: Extracted {0}, restored {1}, skipped {2}, failed {3}.

data.name: ConcurrencyValidation
data.value: Concurrency must be 1 or 2.

data.name: TimeoutValidation
data.value: Timeout must be between 30 and 180 seconds.

data.name: LibraryValidation
data.value: Every media library ID must be a GUID.

data.name: RedirectHostValidation
data.value: Each entry must be an exact DNS name or IP address, or one explicit subdomain rule such as *.example.com. Schemes, paths, ports, and other wildcard forms are not allowed.

data.name: RedirectHostCapacityValidation
data.value: No more than 256 redirect-host rules may be configured.

data.name: ScheduledTaskName
data.value: Extract missing STRM media information

data.name: ScheduledTaskDescription
data.value: Safely probes missing technical media information for supported local STRM files.

data.name: ClearStoredMediaInfoTaskName
data.value: Clear stored STRM Bridge media information

data.name: ClearStoredMediaInfoTaskDescription
data.value: Manually clears STRM Bridge snapshots and extraction state, plus internal technical media information in selected libraries. External streams and media files are retained.

data.name: ScheduledTaskCategory
data.value: Library

data.name: TaskInitializationError
data.value: STRM Bridge has not finished initializing.

data.name: InvalidItemIdError
data.value: The item ID must be a GUID.

data.name: InvalidLibraryIdError
data.value: The library ID must be a GUID.

data.name: AuthenticatedUserRequiredError
data.value: An authenticated Emby user is required.

data.name: AdministratorRequiredError
